Question
========



In dieser Aufgabe geht es um folgenden Originalartikel:

Erlandsson, A., Nilsson, A., Tinghög, G., & Västfjäll, D. (2018). Bullshit-sensitivity predicts prosocial behavior. *PLOS ONE, 13*(7), e0201474. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0201474




Den Volltext können Sie über diese URL ansteuern:

<https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0201474>





```{r}
d2 <- data.frame(
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 check.names = FALSE,
                    Variable = c("Geschlecht","Alter","Bildungsgrad",
                                 "Zahlenbildung (numeracy)","Reflexionsfähigkeit",
                                 "Bearbeitungsdauer des Fragebogens","Religiosität",
                                 "Konservative Orientierung (right wing orientation)",
                                 "Spenden (Donation experience)",
                                 "Ehrenamt (volunteering exeprience)"),
      `Bullshit-receptivity` = c(-0.05,
                                 -0.11,-0.18,-0.3,-0.35,-0.22,0.34,-0.01,
                                 -0.05,-0.21),
  `Profoundness-receptivity` = c(-0.1,0.26,
                                 0.15,0.16,0.16,0.28,0.07,0.03,0.2,0.23)
) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-Variable) %>% 
  mutate(corr_sign = ifelse(value>=0, "positiv", "negativ"))





sol <- 
  d2 %>% 
  mutate(is_incorrect = ifelse(corr_sign == "positiv", "negativ", "positiv")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(Variable, name, value),
               names_to = "correct_sol",
               values_to = "sign") %>% 
  group_by(correct_sol) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter( (correct_sol == "corr_sign" & id == 1) | (correct_sol == "is_incorrect" & between(id, 1, 4))) %>% 
  mutate(proposition = glue("Die Korrelation von *{Variable}* und *{name}* ist *{sign}*.")) %>% 
  mutate(is_correct = case_when(
    correct_sol == "corr_sign" ~ TRUE,
    correct_sol == "is_incorrect" ~ FALSE    
  )) %>% 
  sample_n(size = nrow(.))  # shuffle


```





Wählen Sie die richtige Aussage!




*Hinweise*: 

- *Tiefen-Empfänglichkeit* ist die Übersetzung für *profoundness-receptivity*
- *Bullshit-Empfänglichkeit* ist die Übersetzung für *bullshit-receptivity*


```{r itemlist, results='asis'}
answerlist(sol$proposition, markup = "markdown")
```





Solution
========


Auszug aus dem Artikel:


>    Bivariate correlations

>    The bivariate rank-order correlations between all included variables can be seen in Table 2. Age, level of education, numeracy, reflective ability and time spent completing the survey all correlated positively with profoundness-receptivity, but negatively with bullshit-receptivity (and as a logical consequence positively with bullshit-sensitivity). Religiosity was positively correlated primarily with bullshit-receptivity. Participants’ sex and their political self-placement were only weakly related to bullshit-receptivity and profoundness-receptivity.



Die richtige Aussage lautet: "`r sol$proposition[sol$is_correct]`"


Aufgabenname: `bullshit2`




```{r answerlist, results='asis'}
answerlist(ifelse(sol$is_correct, "Wahr", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
